paper_id: Defeating data hiding in social networks using generative adversarial network
title: Defeating data hiding in social networks using generative adversarial network
venue: EURASIP Journal on Image and Video Processing
motivation: 恐怖分子利用社交网络图像隐藏数据，服务器难以检测，steganalysis在低载荷时不精确且假阳性率高
problem_framing: 不是检测隐藏数据，而是直接去除——通过GAN学习从水印图像到干净图像的映射，阻断隐蔽传输
key_insight: 不同水印算法的数据分布差异大，分开训练模型并随机采样可以防止攻击者发现处理规律，同时保证干净图像不受影响
method_signature: GAN with deep residual generator + discriminator with high-pass filter preprocessing, separate models per watermarking algorithm
evaluation_criteria: 数据提取错误率接近50%表示破坏成功，PSNR和SSIM评估图像质量保持
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 传统攻击要达到足够的数据错误率必然导致图像不可容忍的失真；QIM水印效果最好，SS和ULPM因非盲和纠错码表现稍好
evidence_for_taste: approach 50% means secret data is completely destroyed
traditional attacks will cause intolerable distortion
it can be regarded as a weak noise signal in high frequency
different types of watermarked images have great differences in data distribution
thinking_moves: 把检测问题frame成通信阻断问题——不再追求精确检测，而是直接干扰
水印差异分布导致混合训练不稳定，故采用逐个建模后随机串行
高pass滤波放大水印信号与图像内容的差异，引导discriminator更好分类
借鉴steganalysis的先验知识用于discriminator预处理
